title: Blob

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Blobs are aggressive creatures found in the Swamps. They are large, gelatinous piles of sentient ooze that emit poisonous green gasses.

sections.heading: Area of effect
sections.text: Blobs will stretch slightly before compressing and releasing a cloud of poisonous gas 4 meters in radius, applying the Poison status (90 Poison damage). Despite visual appearances, the cloud does not actually persist and only hits once. This ability can be used when a player is within 2 meters, and it has a cooldown of 2 seconds.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
• Blobs can follow players out to the ocean and jump into boats.
• Entering a Sunken Crypt and leaving Blobs alive there will count towards spawn caps effectively suppressing their spawns in a large area (including the Bonemass ability).

Introduction. Blobs are aggressive creatures found in the Swamps. They are large, gelatinous piles of sentient ooze that emit poisonous green gasses.

Area of effect. Blobs will stretch slightly before compressing and releasing a cloud of poisonous gas 4 meters in radius, applying the Poison status (90 Poison damage). Despite visual appearances, the cloud does not actually persist and only hits once. This ability can be used when a player is within 2 meters, and it has a cooldown of 2 seconds.

Notes. • Blobs can follow players out to the ocean and jump into boats.
• Entering a Sunken Crypt and leaving Blobs alive there will count towards spawn caps effectively suppressing their spawns in a large area (including the Bonemass ability).
